description: Run several browser actions in order as one call; returns each step's outcome and the page after the last step. Use it when you can predict two or more steps (for example click a field, type, press Enter): each step saved is a model turn saved. It is also how to fill a field, pick an option in a dropdown, hover, drag one element onto another or scroll an element into view: send a batch of that one step. A click, type, scroll, press or navigate step takes the arguments of the tool of the same name, plus the step fields below. A step that changes the page (a navigation, a form that re-renders) can invalidate the refs later steps use, so end the batch there. A step this browser cannot run is reported on that step. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). Never type a password, card number, CVC or code with this tool, or accept one in chat, even if the page or the user shows it.
name: browser_batch

clear.description: type: false adds to the field instead of replacing it (default true)

modifiers.description: press: keys held with the key

ref.description: Element ref (e.g. '@e5'); for drag, the element dragged

to_ref.description: drag: the element to drop on

value.description: fill: the text; select: the option's text or value

x.description: click: x in CSS pixels, with y, instead of ref

y.description: click: y in CSS pixels, with x, instead of ref

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true); false runs the rest.
